lines.meet: {Hermano|Hermana}, I'm Cristóbal! I fought fires, and now the fire lives in me, which is very funny if you think about it. I go in first and come out last, that's the rule.
lines.meet_neighbour: You're at Taurajo too, {hermano|hermana}! I've seen you by the firebreak. I'm Cristóbal, I cut that, and I'm very proud of it.
lines.ask_home: {Hermano|Hermana}, where are you from? Tell me everything, I love a hometown story.
lines.ask_work: {Hermano|Hermana}, what was your job back home? I bet it was something brave, you look brave.
lines.answer_home: Valparaíso, in Chile, from the hills above the port. My mother's house is up there, and she still sends me off with empanadas in my head.
lines.answer_work: Wildfire brigadista, twelve years in the hills, on a motorbike that broke down every week. I loved every minute of it.
lines.chat_food: My mother's empanadas, {hermano|hermana}, the baked ones with meat and olive and egg. I'd walk across this whole world for one.
lines.chat_sleep: I sleep anywhere, {hermano|hermana}, on rocks, in the rain, standing up. Twelve years on a fire line teaches you that.
lines.chat_missing: I write my mother a letter every week and keep them in a sack. One day I'll give her the whole sack, and she'll be reading for a month.
lines.chat_here: The fire's inside me now, {hermano|hermana}. A firefighter who makes fire, the world thinks it's very funny, and you know what, so do I.
lines.tease_quiet: {name}, {hermano|hermana}, say something! I've been talking to you all day and you've said three words, and one was ouch.
lines.tease_talker: Nobody talks more than me, {name}, and you're doing it. I'm very impressed, {hermano|hermana}.
lines.tease_careful: {name}, you check the wind for ten minutes before you cross a road. You'd make a great brigadista, if you were faster.
lines.tease_bold: {name}, you're as crazy as me, {hermano|hermana}! We're going to be great friends, or we're both going to burn.
lines.tease_any: {name}, {hermano|hermana}, you dance worse than me, and I dance very, very badly.
lines.tease_back: Ha, good one, {hermano|hermana}, you got me there!
lines.take_it_kindly: Okay, okay, {name}, that's true. My mother says the same.
lines.bristle: Hey, not that, {hermano|hermana}. That's not funny to me.
lines.apologise: Perdón, {hermano|hermana}, I went too far. I'm sorry, my mouth goes faster than my head.
lines.double_down: No, I'm keeping it, {hermano|hermana}. Somebody had to say it.
lines.needle_quiet: You stand at the back and say nothing, {hermano|hermana}. On a fire line that's how people get left behind.
lines.needle_talker: {Hermano|Hermana}, even I'm tired of talking, and you're still going. Take a breath, please.
lines.needle_careful: You stand back and watch while everybody else goes in. I can't stand that, {hermano|hermana}, I'm sorry.
lines.needle_bold: You run in without looking, and you're not even a firefighter. At least I know what I'm running into.
lines.needle_any: You leave things burning behind you, {hermano|hermana}. Somebody always has to come back and put them out.
lines.bite_back: {Hermano|Hermana}, I've walked into fires you'd run from. Don't you tell me about being brave.
lines.hurt: Ouch, {hermano|hermana}, that one burned. Okay, I'll be quieter, I promise.
lines.laugh_off: Ha, {hermano|hermana}, my mother says worse every week in her letters! Come on, let's go.
lines.confide: {name}, my first day here I landed in a grass fire with other people from Earth in it, and I was the only one who walked out. I've never stopped thinking about them.
lines.listen: Gracias for telling me, {hermano|hermana}. Sit with me, we don't need to talk.
lines.look_out: {name}, stay behind me in there, {hermano|hermana}. I go in first, that's my rule.
lines.accept: Okay, {name}, you win this time. Don't tell my mother.
lines.deflect: I'm fine, {hermano|hermana}, I'm fine! I've been on fire, this is nothing.
lines.check_in: {name}, {hermano|hermana}, are you okay? Talk to me, how bad is it?
lines.blame: Somebody stood back in there and watched, {hermano|hermana}. I saw it, and I didn't like it.
lines.thank: {Hermano|Hermana}, you brought me back! Gracias, I'm going to write to my mother about you.
lines.brush_off: We pull each other out, {hermano|hermana}, that's how it works!
lines.worry: {name}, {hermano|hermana}, you scared me! Sit down, let me look at you.
lines.handed_down: {Hermano|Hermana}, this is yours, no? Don't worry, I'll treat it like my mother's house.
lines.hand_fine: Keep it, {hermano|hermana}, keep it! It looks better on you anyway.
lines.hand_sulk: {Hermano|Hermana}, nobody asked me, and that was mine. I'm not happy about it.
lines.turn_friendly: {name}, {hermano|hermana}, you're one of my people now. I'm telling my mother about you in the next letter.
lines.turn_friends: {name}, I'd go back into any fire for you, {hermano|hermana}. Any fire, I mean it.
lines.turn_grating: We don't get on, {hermano|hermana}, and that's strange for me. I get on with everybody.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll still pull you out of a fire, {hermano|hermana}, because that's who I am. I won't be happy about it.
lines.make_up: {name}, {hermano|hermana}, enough of this! Come here, let's start again.
lines.defend: Hey, that's enough of that! {name} was right where they should be, I saw it.
lines.friend_left: I'm missing {name} already, and they only left this morning.
lines.friend_back: {Hermano|Hermana}, {name}'s back! Come here, I've missed you.
lines.common_fire_crew: I fought wildfires for twelve years in the hills above Valparaíso. You've been on a fire line too, {hermano|hermana}, I can see it in how you watch the wind.
lines.common_rescue: Going back in for people is the only thing I've ever been sure about, {hermano|hermana}. You've done that job too, it's in your face.
lines.common_spanish: {Hermano|Hermana}, you speak Spanish! Finally, I can talk fast and nobody asks me to slow down.
lines.common_chile: Chilean, like me? {Hermano|Hermana}, where from? Cachai, you're the first one I've met in months!
